spanish: Y su minjá y sus libaciones a los toros, a los carneros y a los corderos, en su número, conforme al juicio.

findings.issue: H4503 is a common noun (conjunction + feminine singular construct + 3mp suffix). The Spanish leaves it as the untranslated lemma minjá instead of a Spanish common noun.

notes: The other tokens match in conjunctions, number, suffixes, and prepositions.
